title: EventStatus
description: Lifecycle state of a stored event. Events are immutable; their status transitions follow the event-sourcing pattern defined in the UPP specification.

documentation.valid: Current, active, and authoritative event. Included in retrieval results.
documentation.staged: Low-confidence event pending reinforcement. Not included in standard retrieval until promoted to valid.
documentation.superseded: Replaced by a newer event. Retained for audit trail but excluded from retrieval.
